svg.title: Graph Memory: memory-first recall pipeline
svg.desc: A question is recalled from memory before any agent call: it passes through intent, then hybrid BM25 and Qdrant recall. BM25 and Qdrant candidate ids seed ArangoDB multi-hop edge expansion that returns graph paths and receipts. An evidence gate chooses answer, clarify, draft, or scan fresh, while unsupported requests can deflect before recall.

g.text: A semantic match is a lead—not proof.

g.aria-label: Canonical record and graph evidence stage
